title: The Lonely Signal
narration: Somewhere out there, a tiny spacecraft hums. Voyager 1, 166.3 astronomical units from home. Its whisper takes 23 hours to reach us.
visual_goal: Deep space with a faint, distant point of light, then a radio wave traveling across the screen.

title: Launch of Hope
narration: Launched in 1977, it swept past Jupiter's volcanic moons, then Saturn's rings. Each flyby a revelation, each image a new world.
visual_goal: Historical launch footage, then vibrant Jupiter and Saturn imagery with moons.

title: The Pale Blue Dot
narration: In 1990, it turned back. Earth, a pale blue dot, six billion kilometers away. A reminder of our fragile home.
visual_goal: The Pale Blue Dot image, slowly zooming out to show the vastness of space.

title: Silent Endurance
narration: Now it drifts in interstellar space, its power fading. But engineers woke thrusters dormant for 37 years, keeping it alive.
visual_goal: A spacecraft silhouette against starfield, with a heartbeat-like pulse of light.

title: The Golden Whisper
narration: It carries our songs, our greetings, our golden record. A message in a bottle, sailing on forever. Even when silence comes, the whisper remains.
visual_goal: Close-up of the Golden Record, then fade to a starfield with a tiny moving dot.
